technical.summary: Strong technical structure with price above all key MAs and bullish momentum indicators, but extreme overbought conditions (RSI 14: 76.25, StochRSI OB, Williams %R OB) and Hull MA bearish divergence create significant pullback risk; moderate entry quality suitable for risk-managed swing trade only.

fundamental.summary: MKC shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 70 days—insufficient smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (27/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent congressional conviction and unavailable news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (390), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising DXY pressures multinational earnings, and earnings event in 70 days adds execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with bullish supertrend and ADX trending confirmation provides structural support, while extreme market fear (27/100) creates contrarian buy opportunity for risk-managed entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 76.25, StochRSI OB, Williams %R OB), Hull MA bearish divergence, zero fundamental conviction, severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising DXY), and earnings risk in 70 days create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure is sound with price above all major MAs and bullish supertrend, but extreme overbought conditions (RSI 76.25) combined with zero fundamental conviction and severe macro headwinds create unfavorable risk/reward.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme overbought exhaustion (RSI 76.25, StochRSI OB, Williams %R OB) with Hull MA bearish divergence signals imminent pullback risk, compounded by VIX crisis environment and earnings event in 70 days.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding MKC position with 41 existing Consumer Staples positions (10% of portfolio); sector concentration and ticker overlap reduce conviction further.
